scope: Convert the 166 candidate findings from the 2026-08-21 multi-agent audit into executable checks, fix every finding a check confirms, and falsify the rest with evidence. Establish the CI gate the repository has never had.
claim: Given the reproductions recorded in docs/findings/hardening-2026-08.md, the system currently produces the wrong output (RCE via verification_commands, process-killing panics, silent durable data loss, unlocked shared state); after this change each reproduction yields a structured refusal or correct result, proven by a test that fails at base 9278cdf and passes at HEAD.
non_goals: Hosted tenancy, billing, cloud sync, public distribution
Rewriting retrieval quality or ranking semantics beyond determinism fixes
Any behavior change not traceable to a numbered finding in the ledger
risks: Dependency and toolchain bumps (hard risk per policies/risk.json)
Trust-boundary relocation into codeserve.Handle changes refusal behavior on all three surfaces
context.Context threading changes exported codecrawl signatures
Deleting dormant subsystems is irreversible in spirit; each is gated on a DECISIONS.md entry
